screening.section: C1　Healthier SG Screening（原 Screen for Life）
screening.official_page: ask.gov.sg (Healthier SG): [What happened to Screen for Life?](https://ask.gov.sg/healthiersg/questions/cmb7ophun0013za2otmdvcpvf); [Health Appointment System](https://book.health.gov.sg/healthiersg-screening); [CHAS GP Reference Guide, Oct 2025 (PDF)](https://edge.sitecorecloud.io/agencyforinb6cc-agencyforin73f5-production08ac-d178/media/primary-care-pages-pcp/Scheme-and-Programmes/Healthier-SG-Screening/CHAS-GP-Reference-Guide-Oct-2025.pdf); Primary Care Pages [Healthier SG Screening](https://www.primarycarepages.sg/schemes-and-programmes/healthier-sg-screening)
screening.page_date: answer updated 2025-05-28 · guide Oct 2025 · PCP 31 Mar 2026
screening.note_zh: ✅ 「Screen for Life 已改名 Healthier SG Screening」属实，福利不变（预约网站、2025-10 CHAS GP 参考指南也写「前称 Screen for Life」）。**官方没写改名生效日期**；最早有日期的官方说法是这条 2025-05-28 的回答，AIC 页上 2022-11 的通告还用旧名（推断改名在两者之间，非官方原文）。

screening.section: C1　Healthier SG Screening（原 Screen for Life）
screening.item: **Cardiovascular risk screening** — obesity (BMI + waist), blood pressure, blood sugar, blood cholesterol
screening.who: Adults **40 and above** who have **never been diagnosed** with high blood pressure, diabetes or high blood cholesterol, and have not had this screening in the past 3 years
screening.official_page: HealthHub [Screening journey](https://www.healthhub.sg/programmes/healthiersg-screening/screening-journey?age_group=50-and-above&gender=female) · HealthHub [programme page](https://www.healthhub.sg/programmes/healthiersg-screening) · Primary Care Pages [Healthier SG Screening](https://www.primarycarepages.sg/schemes-and-programmes/healthier-sg-screening) (PR test rates)
screening.page_date: HealthHub: not shown · PCP: updated 31 Mar 2026
screening.note_zh: 在参与的 CHAS GP 诊所做，不需要邀请信。公民每次 ≤ $5（PG $0；MG / CHAS 蓝卡橙卡 $2；CHAS 绿卡及其他 $5），含首次复诊；已注册 Healthier SG 的公民在自己的注册诊所 $0。PR：问诊所的 HPB 标准检验价 + 诊金（2026-04-01 起有标准价）。

screening.section: C1　Healthier SG Screening（原 Screen for Life）
screening.item: Already diagnosed with high blood pressure, diabetes or high blood cholesterol
screening.interval_doses: No screening interval — keep regular consultations and routine lab monitoring with the family doctor (no interval stated)
screening.note_zh: ✅ 待核说法属实。国家筛查委员会报告第 5 页的定义：筛查是给**还没被诊断**的无症状者做的检测；因为本身已有该病而做的检查属于**对已有疾病的临床管理**，不算筛查，按临床指南做监测。HealthHub 也写已确诊者不符合资格、应找家庭医生定期复诊和化验。**监测间隔官方没写**。

screening.section: C1　Healthier SG Screening（原 Screen for Life）
screening.interval_doses: Lower risk: repeat the assessment **every 2 years** (sooner if weight, BP, family history etc. change). Higher risk: email invitation to subsidised cardiovascular risk screening at a CHAS GP
screening.note_zh: 40 岁及以上直接做心血管筛查，不用做评估。被判高风险、做完筛查之后多久再筛，官方没写。

screening.section: C1　Healthier SG Screening（原 Screen for Life）
screening.who: Women **25 and above** who have ever been sexually active (no Pap test in past 3 years / no HPV test in past 5 years)
screening.interval_doses: Age 25–29: **Pap test every 3 years**. Age 30+: **HPV test every 5 years**. No upper age limit; from 69, stopping can be discussed with a GP after two negative screens in 10 years (latest within 5 years)
screening.official_page: HealthHub [Screening journey](https://www.healthhub.sg/programmes/healthiersg-screening/screening-journey?age_group=50-and-above&gender=female); HealthHub [Screening FAQ](https://www.healthhub.sg/programmes/healthiersg-screening/screening-faq) (HPV vaccine); STRC 2026 Vol 1; Primary Care Pages [cancer-screening protocol](https://www.primarycarepages.sg/Healthier-SG/Care-Protocols/Preventive/Cancer-Screening); Primary Care Pages [Healthier SG Screening](https://www.primarycarepages.sg/schemes-and-programmes/healthier-sg-screening) (PR test rates, Table 1)
screening.page_date: journey, FAQ: not shown · STRC: Feb 2026 · protocol: 14 Aug 2026 · PCP HSG page: updated 31 Mar 2026
screening.note_zh: 打过 HPV 疫苗也要筛。HealthHub 资格文字写「female Singapore Citizen」，但同页叫 PR 去问诊所价格；PR 标准价 Pap $13 + GST、HPV $48 + GST。结果异常：高危 HPV 转医院做阴道镜，其他高危型一年后复查（异常 ≠ 癌症）。

screening.section: C1　Healthier SG Screening（原 Screen for Life）
screening.who: Adults **50 and above** who have not done a FIT in the past year
screening.interval_doses: **FIT every year** (colonoscopy every 5–10 years is mentioned as an alternative, but only FIT is covered by Healthier SG Screening)
screening.official_page: HealthHub [Screening journey](https://www.healthhub.sg/programmes/healthiersg-screening/screening-journey?age_group=50-and-above&gender=female); Primary Care Pages [protocol](https://www.primarycarepages.sg/Healthier-SG/Care-Protocols/Preventive/Cancer-Screening); Primary Care Pages [Healthier SG Screening](https://www.primarycarepages.sg/schemes-and-programmes/healthier-sg-screening) (PR test rates)
screening.note_zh: 已患大肠癌的人不适用，应定期看医生。FIT 阳性 ≠ 癌症，要进一步检查（多为结肠镜）；两周内没接到协调员电话，打 HPB 1800 223 1313。PR 标准价 $31 + GST（两份试剂盒）。

screening.section: C1　Healthier SG Screening（原 Screen for Life）
screening.who: Women **40–74** with no breast symptoms; 75+ may be offered it after discussing their own risk with a doctor. Not during pregnancy; wait at least 6 months after stopping breastfeeding
screening.official_page: MOH / AMS [STRC 2026 Vol 1](https://isomer-user-content.by.gov.sg/3/15ed4753-8da1-4550-b237-fdabf2b54206/STRC%202026_Volume%201_Feb2026.pdf) (MOH page [3 Feb 2026](https://www.moh.gov.sg/others/resources-and-statistics/strc-2026-volume-1/)); Primary Care Pages [protocol](https://www.primarycarepages.sg/Healthier-SG/Care-Protocols/Preventive/Cancer-Screening); HealthHub [Screening journey](https://www.healthhub.sg/programmes/healthiersg-screening/screening-journey?age_group=50-and-above&gender=female); HealthHub [Screening FAQ](https://www.healthhub.sg/programmes/healthiersg-screening/screening-faq) (pregnancy / breastfeeding); [Health Appointment System](https://book.health.gov.sg/healthiersg-screening) (eligibility accordion)
screening.page_date: STRC Feb 2026 · protocol 14 Aug 2026 · journey, FAQ, booking site: not shown
screening.note_zh: ⚠️ **官方页面之间不一致**：2026 年报告把年龄从 50–69 改为 40–74，GP 规程（2026-08-14）已采用；但预约网站的资格栏还写「50 岁以上，40–49 岁先问医生」，HealthHub FAQ 第 5 题只写「50 岁以上、每两年」（同一 FAQ 的乳腺第 2 题又写 40–49 岁每年一次）。只在参与的综合诊疗所做；价格 $0（已注册 HSG 公民）/ PG $25 / MG $37.50 / 公民 $50 / PR $75。有乳房症状不走筛查，直接看医生（B2）。

screening.section: C1　Healthier SG Screening（原 Screen for Life）
screening.item: Functional screening for seniors (vision, hearing, oral health) — **Project Silver Screen**
screening.who: Citizens and PRs **60 and above** not screened in the past 12 months
screening.interval_doses: Once at least 12 months have passed since the last one; **fully subsidised from 1 Sep 2026** (follow-up care or devices may cost extra)
screening.note_zh: **不属于 Healthier SG Screening**，是另一个项目。

screening.section: C1　Healthier SG Screening（原 Screen for Life）
screening.item: National screening recommendations behind the programme (for clinicians)
screening.who: Diabetes: 40+ · Lipids: 40+ · Blood pressure: 18+ · Obesity (BMI + waist): 18+
screening.interval_doses: Diabetes (FPG or HbA1c) every 3 years · lipids every 3 years · blood pressure opportunistically and at least yearly · BMI + waist yearly
screening.note_zh: 这是面向医生的全国建议，**不等于**补贴项目的资格（补贴项目是 40 岁起、每 3 年）。有危险因素的人群建议更早 / 更频繁，由医生判断。

screening.section: C2　国家成人免疫计划 NAIS（现行版：2026-04-01）
screening.note_zh: NAIS 现在挂在传染病管理局（CDA）页面上，MOH 旧地址已跳转过来。2025-08-21 那份 PDF 已被取代；两版之间唯一实质改动是乙肝的肾病 4 剂方案。**HealthHub 上的 NAIS PDF 链接还指向 2020 年的旧图（没有 PCV20、没有带状疱疹疫苗），别用。**

screening.section: C2　国家成人免疫计划 NAIS（现行版：2026-04-01）
screening.item: **Claim check: PCV20 and Shingrix added from 2025-09-01**
screening.official_page: MOH / CDA [press release, 29 Aug 2025](https://www.moh.gov.sg/newsroom/new-vaccines-against-shingles-and-pneumococcal-disease-added-to-national-adult-immunisation-schedule/); [MOH Circular 03/2025](https://isomer-user-content.by.gov.sg/7/18bc4545-014a-4725-adf1-8440bdf1f372/MOH%20Cir%2003_2025%20Inclusion%20of%20Shingles%20Vaccine%20and%20Updates%20to%20Pneumococcal%20Vaccine%20in%20NAIS.pdf) (10 Feb 2025)
screening.note_zh: ✅ 属实，2025-09-01 起两种疫苗加入并开始补贴；旧版 PDF（含 2020 年图）里没有。补充：PCV20 是作为**替代方案**加入的，PCV13 / PPSV23 没有被移除；已经打过 PCV13 / PPSV23 的人可以问医生要不要打 PCV20；打过活疫苗 Zostavax 的人也可以再打 Shingrix。

screening.section: C2　国家成人免疫计划 NAIS（现行版：2026-04-01）
screening.who: All adults **65+**; adults 18+ with long-term lung or heart conditions (incl. asthma), diabetes or other chronic metabolic, kidney, nerve, liver or blood conditions, or immunosuppression (needing follow-up or hospital care); people on **long-term aspirin therapy**; **pregnant women** (any stage); people receiving intermediate / long-term care services
screening.interval_doses: **1 dose every year or every season**
screening.note_zh: 长期服阿司匹林的人在流感疫苗对象里（原因：流感后有 Reye 综合征风险）——和本项目的阿司匹林用户相关。原文这一条写「Persons age 18 years」没写「or older」，字面有歧义。2026-09 有临时季节性建议（北半球疫苗晚两周到货），见 CDA [4 Sep 2026 update](https://www.cda.gov.sg/news-and-events/update-on-seasonal-influenza-vaccination/)，是临时的。

screening.section: C2　国家成人免疫计划 NAIS（现行版：2026-04-01）
screening.who: All adults **65+**; adults 18+ with chronic lung, heart or liver disease, diabetes, a cochlear implant or CSF leak, an immunocompromising condition, or chronic kidney disease
screening.note_zh: 可以选 PCV20 一针，或按原来的 PCV13 和 / 或 PPSV23 方案。MOH Circular 03/2025 的 PCV20 对象里多列了「无脾或脾功能缺失」，现行 NAIS PDF、CDA 和 MOH 页面都没有这一条（待确认）。

screening.section: C2　国家成人免疫计划 NAIS（现行版：2026-04-01）
screening.who: PCV13: 65+; adults 18+ with a cochlear implant or CSF leak, an immunocompromising condition, or chronic kidney disease. PPSV23: 65+; adults 18+ with the same conditions as PCV20
screening.interval_doses: PCV13: 1 dose, given first. PPSV23: 1 or 2 doses depending on age / condition, after PCV13 when both are needed
screening.note_zh: 两针之间隔多久、什么情况打 1 针或 2 针，NAIS 没写数字。

screening.section: C2　国家成人免疫计划 NAIS（现行版：2026-04-01）
screening.who: All adults **60+**; adults 18+ with an immunocompromising condition (immunodeficiency, or immunosuppression from treatment)
screening.interval_doses: **2 doses, 2–6 months apart** (1–2 months apart possible if immunocompromised)
screening.official_page: NAIS PDF, p.5; HealthHub [Shingles vaccine leaflet](https://www.healthhub.sg/medication-devices-and-treatment/medications/shingles-herpes-zoster-vaccine) (examples of immunocompromising conditions); MOH [Healthier SG Vaccinations](https://www.moh.gov.sg/managing-expenses/schemes-and-subsidies/healthier-sg-vaccinations/) (cost)
screening.note_zh: 打过活疫苗（HZVL / Zostavax）的，一般至少隔 5 年再打 RHZV。已注册 Healthier SG 的公民在注册诊所打 NAIS 疫苗免费，**只有 RHZV 仍需封顶自付**。

screening.section: C2　国家成人免疫计划 NAIS（现行版：2026-04-01）
screening.interval_doses: **1 dose in every pregnancy**, between weeks 16 and 32 (a dose after week 32 can be considered)
screening.note_zh: 目的是保护新生儿免受百日咳。

screening.section: C2　国家成人免疫计划 NAIS（现行版：2026-04-01）
screening.interval_doses: **3 doses** (months 0, 1, 6); if started by 26, the rest can be finished up to age 45
screening.note_zh: 旧版 HealthHub 图写的是 HPV2 或 HPV4，现行版只列 HPV2。

screening.section: C2　国家成人免疫计划 NAIS（现行版：2026-04-01）
screening.who: Adults with no evidence of immunity or past infection
screening.interval_doses: **3 doses** (months 0, 1, 6). Chronic kidney disease stage 4–5 and / or dialysis: **4 doses** (months 0, 1, 2, 6)
screening.note_zh: 肾病方案是 2026-04-01 版新增内容。PDF 里写了每剂微克数，按规矩没搬进表。
